kashika: यतश्च निर्धारणमिति वर्तते। षष्ठीसप्तम्यपवादो योगः। विभागो विभक्तम्। यस्मिन् निर्धारणाश्रये विभक्तमस्यास्ति, ततः पञ्चमी विभक्तिर्भवति। माथुराः पाटलिपुत्रकेभ्यः सुकुमारतराः, आढ्यतराः॥
kashikaEnglish: When the specified differs from the group, ablative is used: माथुराः पाटलिपुत्रेभ्यः सुकुमारतराः 'Mathura people are more delicate than those of Pāṭaliputra'.
englishFull:
The 5th case-affix (ablative) is used when what is specified is DIFFERENT from (not included in) the class.

This debars genitive and locative.

**Example:**
माथुराः पाटलिपुत्रेभ्यः सुकुमारतराः "The Mathurāns are more delicate than the Pāṭaliputrans"

The two groups are distinct, not one within the other.
